hold_ceiling.rule: max(3, 0.5% of the set, rounded down)
hold_ceiling.plain: four disputed closes on one night refuse the whole settled-close file and every stock loses its % change. This batch adds 26 funds and no room.

recommendation.why: the danger is in the visible midnight steps, which move every name to a new digest and are the same for 13 funds as for 26; two sittings run them twice. No limit is easier at 13 (the ceiling is 3 either way), and a bad fund is dropped by name at the gate before anything visible.
conditions: the Geiger cycle time read at 599 is 191 seconds or less
the settled-close preflight names fewer than four names
recommendation.if_a_condition_fails: not that night (splitting would not fix either)

capacity_notes: Hold ceiling: 3 at 599 and 3 at 625. 15 of the 26 trade about a million shares a day or more, 11 trade 150 thousand to a million.
Geiger: a cycle every 240 s, retries stop at 200 s, 7 requests a name, 8 at a time (default; live setting not read). 599 x 7 = 4,193 requests; 625 x 7 = 4,375 (+182, +4.3%).
To finish inside 200 s a request may average 382 ms at 599 and 366 ms at 625. If the cycle takes T seconds at 599, expect about 1.043 T at 625: T must be 191 s or less.
T at 599 is NOT KNOWN: it must be read after TR1's sitting and before this one.
The map step is one command per fund: 26 commands.
The admission checklist probes widths for 80 names or fewer: 26 is inside it (624 width probes).
